title: Fact or Fiction: Can We Trust Jesus?
scope: One journey for user review; broader benchmark stopped at user request.

cards.text:
Can we trust the story of Jesus?

Many people wonder if the gospels are history or just myth. Let's take a quick look at the evidence.

Start the journey

Why does it matter?

If the story is fiction, it changes nothing. If it's history, it changes everything. Trust begins with the facts.

edits.prompt: Make a side-by-side-in-sequence comparison using three consecutive video cards. All three must use the exact same Fact or Fiction library video and the same 0–133 second clip, in dark mode. Use the native Fit, Fill and Crop options, not different video clips. After Crop, continue to the existing reflection card. Keep the welcome background video, all existing text and all response cards unchanged.
